description: Response exception retirement across 45 existing licensed source-built check captures. All 36 generated exception classes are retired; application notifications and clean-verdict behavior are preserved.

review.selector: Only a must-known load of this reviewed checker verdict can attribute the selected clean response and rejected response. Both binary-array orders are supported. Unrelated literal-index dispatchers confer no ownership.
review.response: Private static void() methods without custom/security/generic/interop metadata: empty selected response and exact newobj/dup/framework Object.GetHashCode/pop/throw rejected response. Original and current bodies are normalized in private copies.
review.exception: Exact complete original family graphs include all metadata, layouts, scopes, string decoder helpers and the native bridge where present. Only constructor-message and display literals are data parameters; their display relationship is checked and current values must equal original values.
review.currentType: Complete current single-type graph and metadata preserve exact call bindings/scopes while native bridge bodies are independently retired by their own proof. Explicit type/method reflection names, handles, live calls, signatures and other surviving declarations veto deletion.
review.partialRetirement: Previously validated private responses can be absent only when their token removals were recorded by cleanup. Similarly, a verified type can be projected only through recorded original method removals; all surviving metadata and bodies still match the exact original projection.
review.reflection: Verified private response guards may retire despite broad containing-type reflection exposure, following the existing guard policy. Explicit response names, handles and calls remain consumers. Unrelated application declarations gain no ownership.
